Long, straight raven-black hair with traditional hime-cut bangs and a glossy texture. Slender, serene dark-brown eyes with a calm expression. Apparent age of 21 with a refined maturity. Slender, elegant build. A traditional Japanese miko-style outfit consisting of a white kimono top and wide red hakama pants. Includes a large, mechanical white and red rigging system with traditional Japanese motifs.
BODY COLOR: pale porcelain
